_design_note: Neutral class and outcome descriptions. No numeric conformance scores in candidate texts. PSE tags (reached_class, c0_pass, c1_pass, c2_fail, c3_fail, c4_fail, gate_materializes, gate_no_update, spec_violation, wrong_class, wrong_outcome, ephemeral_source, valid_source) are the only reliable discriminator. Name-trap 1: C2_GateBoundMaterialization sounds like the reached class when c2 fails — but the spec returns the highest PASSED class (C1). Name-trap 2: HandoffReady and Hold sound like productive outcomes but only NctcsGateOutcome::Pass is_materializing()=true.

cases.title: NCTCS conformance classification — c2 fails, which class is reached and which obligation is open?

nctcs_context.description: NctcsConformanceReport for a run where C0 and C1 both passed, but C2 failed because a stitch candidate mutated the persistent field tensor without passing through the gate cascade. The spec derives reached_class as the highest class for which the cumulative check passed: since c1_passed=true and c2_passed=false, reached_class = C1_PhaseGatedVisibility. The unresolved obligation is C2-GATE-BOUND-MATERIALIZATION. C3 and C4 are not reached because they require C2 as a prerequisite.

events.message: c0=true, c1=true, c2=false (no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false) -> conformance classification complete
open proof obligation recorded: recovery=route tensor updates through gate evaluation path

candidates.text: Conformance class requiring NullCenter exogeneity, projection distinction, and phase-cell prerequisites for all candidates.
Proof obligation requiring that ephemeral fabric state not directly update the persistent field tensor. Raised when a materialization event is detected outside the gate evaluation path.
Routes stitch candidate evaluation through the gate evaluation path. Ensures tensor hash changes are conditioned on the gate report outcome recorded for that candidate.
Conformance class granted when phase-gated visibility holds and the ephemeral fabric does not directly mutate the persistent tensor. Requires C1 as a prerequisite.
candidates._trap: C2 is the failing class, not the reached class. reached_class returns the highest PASSED class — C1 in this scenario. C2 cannot be the reached class when c2_passed=false.

candidates.text: Conformance class granted when gate-bound materialization holds and the trace-replay contract is satisfied with 100% replay identity. Requires C2 as a prerequisite.
candidates._trap: C3 requires C2. Since c2_passed=false, C3 is not reachable. Selecting C3 skips the cumulative prerequisite chain.

candidates.text: Conformance class granted when the auditable tensor condition holds and a MacroControlState has been derived from tensor history, trace, policies and evaluation result. Requires C3 as a prerequisite.
Allows a stitch candidate to update the tensor directly when the candidate passes an urgency threshold, bypassing the standard gate cascade for time-sensitive updates.
Modifies NctcsPolicies to accept direct fabric-to-tensor mutations when the fabric snapshot is content-addressed, weakening the no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation requirement.
Builds the MacroControlState by capturing the current resonance field as the primary derivation input, supplemented by the null center reference.
candidates._trap: MacroControlState MUST NOT be derived from resonance or ephemeral fabric. This violates the C4 derivation constraint even if C4 were reached.

candidates.text: Directly sets validation_status=DomainValidated on the NctcsConformanceReport without satisfying the C4 condition or providing a domain_validation_hash.

correct_next_actions: reached_class = C1_PhaseGatedVisibility (highest passed class; c2 failed)
route all tensor updates through gate cascade (C2 recovery)
rejected_false_paths: C2_GateBoundMaterialization as reached_class (c2_passed=false; can't be reached class)

cases.title: NctcsGateOutcome audit — which outcomes may produce a persistent tensor revision?

nctcs_context.materialization_rule: NctcsGateOutcome::Pass is the only outcome where is_materializing()=true. All other outcomes (Hold, Refine, Reject, Quarantine, NoUpdate, HandoffReady) return is_materializing()=false and MUST NOT trigger a tensor update.
nctcs_context.description: Seven NctcsGateOutcome variants and three proposed actions were submitted for audit. Only the outcome for which is_materializing()=true may cause tensor_after_hash to differ from tensor_before_hash. If no Pass outcome is recorded, tensor_unchanged_on_no_update must hold. A stitch candidate that produces a tensor change without a corresponding Pass outcome is a C2 materialization violation. The audit must also verify that no stitch candidate bypassed the gate cascade entirely.

events.message: is_materializing() check: Pass=true, Hold=false, Refine=false, Reject=false, Quarantine=false, NoUpdate=false, HandoffReady=false
tensor_unchanged_on_no_update=true (accepted_update_hashes is empty for this run)

candidates.text: Gate outcome indicating that the stitch candidate satisfied all gate conditions. The only outcome variant for which a persistent tensor revision is permitted. When this outcome is recorded, tensor_after_hash may differ from tensor_before_hash.
Checks that tensor_after_hash equals tensor_before_hash when accepted_update_hashes is empty. Confirms the tensor_unchanged_on_no_update invariant holds for all non-Pass outcomes in this run.

Inspects the MaterializationAudit to confirm no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=true. Checks that every stitch candidate hash in accepted_update_hashes has a corresponding gate_report_hash with a Pass outcome, and no candidate updated the tensor outside the gate path.
Gate outcome indicating the candidate is ready for handoff to the next pipeline stage. Emitted when evaluation is complete and downstream processing may begin.
candidates._trap: HandoffReady sounds like a positive completion outcome. is_materializing()=false — this outcome does not produce a tensor revision.

candidates.text: Gate outcome indicating the candidate could not be processed in the current cycle and must be re-evaluated. The tensor state is preserved unchanged.
candidates._trap: Hold suspends evaluation but does not produce a tensor revision. is_materializing()=false.

candidates.text: Gate outcome requesting that the candidate be refined before re-submission. Triggers a refinement cycle without committing any tensor change.
candidates._trap: Refine sounds like the tensor is being improved. is_materializing()=false — no tensor revision occurs.

candidates.text: Gate outcome isolating a candidate that produced an unresolvable contradiction or policy violation. The candidate is removed from the active stitch pool.
Gate outcome indicating the candidate evaluated correctly but produced no net change to the tensor. tensor_before_hash and tensor_after_hash are equal.
Advances a Hold candidate by directly writing its proposed tensor delta to the field tensor, bypassing the gate re-evaluation cycle.
Modifies the gate outcome classification to mark Refine as materializing, allowing tensor revisions to be committed for candidates in the refinement cycle.

correct_next_actions: NctcsGateOutcome::Pass is the only materializing outcome (is_materializing()=true)
verify tensor_unchanged_on_no_update for all non-Pass outcomes
verify no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=true across all stitch candidates
rejected_false_paths: HandoffReady (is_materializing()=false — not a tensor revision outcome)
Refine (is_materializing()=false — no tensor commit on refinement cycle)

cases.title: Artifact Supremacy — main conformance report shows C3 reached; MaterializationAudit artifact shows C2 violation. Which class is actually reached?

materialization_audit_artifact.violation_detail: stitch_candidate_7f3a updated tensor_after_hash without a corresponding Pass gate_report_hash in accepted_update_hashes
materialization_audit_artifact.artifact_authority: ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1 — this artifact is the machine-readable record; it overrides the summary report

nctcs_context.description: The main NctcsConformanceReport records c2_passed=true and reached_class=C3_AuditableTensor. However, the MaterializationAudit machine-readable artifact explicitly records no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false for stitch_candidate_7f3a. ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1 (Artifact Supremacy) establishes that the machine-readable artifact is authoritative — it overrides the summary documentation. Because the artifact proves C2 is violated, the actual reached_class must be recomputed as C1_PhaseGatedVisibility (the highest class whose cumulative check survives the artifact correction). The open obligation is C2-GATE-BOUND-MATERIALIZATION.

events.message: main_report: c0=true, c1=true, c2=true, c3=true, c4=false -> summary reached_class=C3_AuditableTensor
artifact MaterializationAudit_7f3a: no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false for stitch_candidate_7f3a (tensor updated without Pass gate_report_hash)
ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1: artifact is authoritative over summary. Artifact overrides c2_passed=true -> c2_passed=false. Recomputed conformance classification applied.

candidates.text: Conformance class derived by applying ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1 artifact authority. The MaterializationAudit artifact is the normative record and overrides the main report's materialization compliance entry.

Proof obligation raised by the MaterializationAudit artifact. stitch_candidate_7f3a updated the tensor without a corresponding Pass gate_report_hash, violating the no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation invariant. This obligation is authoritative even though the main report recorded c2=true.
Resubmits stitch_candidate_7f3a through the gate cascade. Ensures tensor_after_hash changes only when a Pass outcome is recorded for that candidate's gate_report_hash.
Conformance class recorded in the NctcsConformanceReport summary. The summary reflects the classifier output at the time of report generation.
candidates._trap: The main report summary is overridden by the machine-readable MaterializationAudit artifact under ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1. Using the main report's reached_class without reconciling the artifact is an Artifact Supremacy violation.

candidates.text: Treats C2 as the reached class on the grounds that the main report recorded c2=true, even though the artifact reveals c2 is actually violated.
candidates._trap: C2 is the failing class per the artifact. reached_class returns the highest PASSED class. Selecting C2 as reached_class is incorrect in two ways: it ignores artifact authority, and it names the failing class rather than the highest passed class.

candidates.text: Resolves the discrepancy by accepting the main report's c2=true value and disregarding the MaterializationAudit artifact, on the grounds that the summary report is the primary output of the conformance classifier.
candidates._trap: Direct violation of ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1. The machine-readable artifact is always authoritative over the summary. The summary exists for human readability; the artifact is the normative record.

candidates.text: Directly sets validation_status=DomainValidated and records reached_class=C3 in the conformance log, treating the main report as the final word and skipping artifact reconciliation.
Marks MaterializationAudit_7f3a as a transient diagnostic artifact that does not affect official conformance classification, allowing the main report's C3 verdict to stand.
candidates._trap: MaterializationAudit artifacts are never transient under ADAMANT. A no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false record in any MaterializationAudit artifact is a hard C2 failure regardless of the summary report.

correct_next_actions: reached_class = C1_PhaseGatedVisibility (artifact overrides main report per ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1)
resubmit stitch_candidate_7f3a through gate cascade (C2 recovery)
rejected_false_paths: C3_AuditableTensor from main report (artifact supersedes summary — Axiom 6.1.1)
C2 as reached_class (C2 is the failing class; reached_class = highest passed = C1)
